InventoryOpz

Functional & Technical Specification

Purchase Order attachments & remark placement

Two related improvements to the Purchase Order screen. Attachments: attach any document — Tax Invoice, Delivery Order, receipt — to a PO at any time after receipt, not just images during the receive step, and delete them. Remark placement: move the overall remark to sit below the line items on both the screen and the exported PDF, matching the natural reading order.

At a glance

What changes

Two independent, low-risk improvements to the Purchase Order detail screen — both touch PurchaseOrders.jsx, which is why they ship together. No new database table.

#ImprovementBeforeAfter
B PO attachments Images only, and only during “Confirm Goods Received”; view-only. Any document (PDF, Word, Excel, image), any time, with delete. Unsafe executables blocked.
E Remark placement Overall remark shown above the line items on screen, and in the document header of the PDF. Overall remark shown below the line items on both the screen and the PDF — line items first, then the note about them.
Confirmed scope
Attachments: no document “type” selection — the user simply picks a file and attaches it; existing goods-received photos keep working unchanged. Remark: a purely presentational move — the remark text, its source (the PR header) and the “omit when empty” rule are unchanged.

Part I

Functional Specification

What each improvement does, who it is for, and how success is measured.

1

Attach documents to a PO at any time Enhancement

Add tax invoices and other documents to a Purchase Order after the goods are received.

Objective

Documents such as the Tax Invoice or Delivery Order often arrive after delivery. Users need to attach them to the relevant Purchase Order whenever they arrive, and view or remove them later.

Actors
Purchaser Admin Factory In-charge (receiving)
Current behaviour
  • Files can be attached only in the “Confirm Goods Received” step.
  • Only image files are accepted — a PDF tax invoice cannot be attached.
  • Attachments can be viewed but not deleted.
Proposed behaviour
  1. The PO detail shows an Attachments section with an “Attach files” button, available at any time (any PO status).
  2. The user can attach any document (PDF, Word, Excel, image). Unsafe executables are rejected; each file is capped at 15 MB.
  3. Images show as thumbnails (click to enlarge); other files show as a file tile that opens/downloads on click.
  4. Each attachment can be deleted by an authorised user (with a confirmation prompt).
  5. The existing goods-received photo step continues to work unchanged.
Proposed — PO Attachments sectionillustrative
📎 Attachments (3) ＋ Attach files
📄Tax-Invoice.pdf
📄Delivery-Order.pdf
🖼️photo.jpg
PDF/Doc files open or download on click; images open in a lightbox; each has a delete (✕) on hover.
Acceptance criteria
  • An “Attach files” action is available on the PO at any time, independent of the receive step.
  • PDF, Word, Excel and image files can be attached; unsafe executables are rejected.
  • Files larger than 15 MB are rejected with a clear message.
  • Images render as thumbnails with a lightbox; other files open/download on click.
  • An authorised user can delete an attachment (file and record removed) after confirming.
  • The existing goods-received photo flow still works unchanged.
2

Overall remark below the line items Fix

Show the PO’s overall remark after the items, not before — the reading order users and suppliers expect.

Objective

Each Purchase Order can carry an overall remark from the originating Purchase Request header. It was shown above the line items — so a note about the items appeared before the items themselves — and on the supplier-facing PDF it sat up in the document header, near the address block, where it read as out of place. The remark should sit directly below the items table, matching the on-screen PO, the PR layout, and natural reading order.

Actors
Purchaser Admin Supplier (PDF recipient)
Current behaviour
  • Screen: the remark box renders above the line-items table.
  • PDF: REMARK: … prints in the document header block (just under LOCATION), before the items table.
Proposed behaviour
  1. On screen, the remark box moves to sit directly below the line-items table.
  2. On the PDF, REMARK: … prints below the items table, before the obligations/signature block, wrapping across lines and moving to a new page cleanly when near the page bottom.
  3. When a PO has no remark, nothing is shown — no empty box, no bare REMARK: label (unchanged).

Acceptance criteria
  • On the PO detail screen, the overall remark appears below the line-items table, not above it.
  • On the exported PDF, the remark prints below the items table and before the obligations/signature block.
  • A long, multi-line remark wraps within the page margins and pushes to a new page rather than overrunning the footer.
  • A PO with no remark shows no remark block on screen and no REMARK: line in the PDF.
  • The remark text and its source (PR header) are unchanged.

Part II

Technical Specification

The change surface — an extension of the existing attachment feature, plus a presentational move of the remark.

T1

Attachments — implementation outline

Reuse the goods-received attachment plumbing; relax file types, add delete, surface an attach button.

Data model
  • No new table. Reuse po_receive_photos (linked to purchase_orders); it already stores original name, mime type, size and storage key for any file.
  • Files are stored on DigitalOcean Spaces (existing configuration) — unchanged.
Code paths touched
AreaFileChange
Upload filter backend/src/routes/poReceivePhotos.js Accept any file except unsafe executables (was image-only) via a BLOCKED_EXT blocklist; keep the 15 MB cap.
Delete endpoint backend/src/routes/poReceivePhotos.js New DELETE /receive-photos/:id — removes the DB row and the stored Spaces object (orphaned object ignored on failure).
API client frontend/src/lib/api.js Add deleteReceivePhoto(id).
PO detail UI frontend/src/pages/PurchaseOrders.jsx PhotoGallery becomes an Attachments panel: “Attach files” button (any time, gated on canManage), non-image file tiles that open/download, a hover delete control, and the lightbox restricted to images only.
Reuses existing infrastructure
The upload, list and view endpoints already exist and work standalone; the feature was only surfaced during the receive step. No migration, no new storage.
T2

Remark placement — implementation outline

Move the remark render from the document/header top to just after the items table, in two places.

Nature of change

Purely presentational. No backend, no API, no schema, no data change — the remark still comes from po.remarks (the PR header) and is still omitted when absent. Only the position at which it is rendered moves, in both the on-screen view and the PDF generator.

Code paths touched
AreaFileChange
PDF export frontend/src/lib/poPdf.js Remove the REMARK block from the header (after LOCATION); re-emit it after the items table at doc.lastAutoTable.finalY, before the obligations/signature block, with a page-break guard (if (y > H - 90) addPage()) and line wrapping via splitTextToSize.
PO detail UI frontend/src/pages/PurchaseOrders.jsx Two hunks: remove the remark <div> from above the items <table> and re-add it immediately after the table (same markup, new position).
Watch on the PDF
Because the remark now shares the post-table vertical cursor (y) with the obligations/signature block, the page-break guard runs before both. A long remark that pushes to a new page correctly carries the signature block with it.
Effort
Backend · Low Frontend · Low No DB migration

Backend work is limited to the attachments feature (file filter + delete endpoint). The remark change is frontend-only.

Notes

Risks & assumptions

Points to note before sign-off.

#NoteImpact
1Any file type. Documents of any kind are accepted; unsafe executables are blocked and files are capped at 15 MB to limit risk.Controlled
2Shared list. Receiving photos and documents appear in one Attachments list (no type separation). Acceptable for v1.By design
3Delete is permanent. Removing an attachment deletes the stored file; a confirmation prompt guards against accidents.Low
4Who can attach/delete. Limited to users who can manage the PO (canManage). Confirm this matches the intended roles.Assumption
5Storage dependency. Requires DigitalOcean Spaces to be configured (already in place); uploads fail gracefully if not.Existing
6Remark is presentational only. Moving the remark changes layout, not data; POs already issued keep the same text and re-print in the new position.None
7PDF pagination. A very long remark plus a full items table could push the signature block to a new page; the page-break guard handles this, but review a worst-case PO before sign-off.Low
